provenance: Frozen 2026-11-21 · drafted blind by a Claude Code subagent (Opus 5.5) that never saw any setup's output
method: Listed title, agency and type for all 448 documents, and read the abstract for the 215 not from plainly out-of-scope agencies (SEC, FAA, FERC, OFAC, NPS repatriation notices, NIH, NRC, FEMA flood maps, DOJ Antitrust, Civil Rights Commission, ITA trade cases, CMS/Medicare). Federal Register raw_text_url was captcha-blocked, so full text came from govinfo.gov: 47 shortlisted documents were fetched and the SUMMARY, DATES and relevant tables/sections were read for 38 of them; the remaining shortlisted items were judged on title and abstract. Inclusion rule: relevant only if the document falls in one of the profile's 'applies' categories for the company's actual products, crops, SNAP-driven sales, plants or fleet; pesticide registration cancellations were treated as outside 'residue limits' unless they changed a tolerance. Deadlines are the nearest actionable date as published (objection deadline for the FDA color additive orders, comment deadline for proposed rules, effective date for the confirmed Orange B order), quoted verbatim from the DATES section and checked against the structured dates.

deadline.quote: The effective date of September 8, 2026, for the final order published in the Federal Register of July 23, 2026 (91 FR 46276) is confirmed.
